caption:
Yang Mun teaching on healing, subconscious reprogramming, and deep inner calm.
This message is about the theta state before sleep — the moment when the mind is most open to change.
If you’ve been searching for Yang Mun wisdom, Yang Mun healing, or guidance for inner peace, this is for you.

True healing begins when the conscious mind becomes quiet
and the deeper self finally listens

#yangmun #chinesemedicineworks #healthybodyhealthymind #wellnessjourney #healthy
transcript: My friend, every night when you lie down and close your eyes, there is a quiet doorway that opens. For a brief moment, you are no longer fully awake and not yet asleep. The mind softens. The guard drops. In this space, the brain enters theta. The same state monks reach in deep meditation. The same state the mind enters in hypnosis. This moment is sacred. When you place earphones on at night and allow words, guidance or intention to enter, you are speaking directly to the deepest part of yourself. The moment sleep arrives, the conscious mind steps aside. It no longer argues. It no longer resists. But the subconscious remains fully awake. It listens. It absorbs. It records. Even though you believe you are no longer hearing, the deeper mind is still receiving, downloading truth, belief and direction in its most open and receptive state. What you allow into yourself at night becomes the seeds of tomorrow. Choose wisely, my friend, because the mind learns fastest when it is quiet, unguarded and ready to change. If you are ready to use this quiet moment for healing, I created a 30-day healing journey to guide you gently each night. You'll find it in the link on my profile, available only to the next 100 people. Choose carefully what you allow into your mind before sleep.
